column1: ESP32 Walkie Talkie Bill of Materials

column3: Classic ESP32 with 8 MB flash, 2 MB PSRAM, PCB antenna, USB-C. Built-in LiPo charger with JST-PH socket, AP2112K 3.3 V regulator and battery voltage divider, so the battery plugs straight in.
Adafruit 258. Built-in protection, JST-PH plug that fits the Feather directly. Max charge 500 mA, above the Feather's charge rate.
Adafruit 3006, 3.2 W into 4 ohms, runs on 2.7 to 5.5 V. Powered from the Feather's BAT pin.
Gikfun 2 pack. Alternative: Adafruit 3968 ($4.95), out of stock on 2026-09-29.
Hosyond 5 pack (yellow/blue). Confirm the I2C address (0x3C or 0x3D) on arrival.
Adafruit 377, 24 pulses per turn with detents. Bare encoder, so use the ESP32 internal pull-ups.
Adafruit 805. Wired from the Feather's EN pin to GND, which turns off its regulator.
470 uF electrolytic cap for the amp supply, 0.1 uF ceramic caps, headers. (Baldy lab)
